rules_applied: Values read from code only. Where a comment disagrees with the code, the code value is given and the disagreement is recorded in _comment_conflicts.

Env-gated values are given at the shipped/default configuration (data/model_config.json, which the bake/gate loader pins and which equals every code default). The gate name is recorded beside each such value.
The engine was not run. Tables are transcribed, not evaluated.

kernel.growth_loop: while h < 0.60: if sum(exp(-0.5*((log_pick - log_p)/h)^2)) >= 35 break; h += 0.02

the position has no populated band at all -> row[b] = POOL[b]
then the cross-band monotone clamp: for b in 1..NB-1, row[b] = min(row[b], row[b-1]) — a later pick can never out-baseline an earlier one; applied to ALL bands (was 1..5 before v3.4)
